permissions.tagline: Off-grid messaging over Bluetooth and the internet.
permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.intro: Each one switches on a feature. Grant what you like: XPRS works with whatever you allow, and you can change it later in Settings > Permissions.
permissions.privacy: Your data stays on your device. These permissions are only used for local messaging and connectivity.
permissions.bluetooth.title: Bluetooth
permissions.bluetooth.desc: Discover nearby devices and exchange messages over the mesh
permissions.nearby_wifi.title: Nearby WiFi devices
permissions.nearby_wifi.desc: Move large files between nearby devices over a direct WiFi link (much faster than Bluetooth)
permissions.notifications.title: Notifications
permissions.notifications.desc: Alert you when a message arrives while the app is in the background
permissions.storage.title: Storage
permissions.storage.desc: Keep an encrypted backup of your identity so it survives a reinstall, and share files
permissions.storage_legacy.title: Storage
permissions.storage_legacy.desc: Keep an encrypted backup of your identity so it survives a reinstall, and share files
permissions.location.title: Location
permissions.location.desc: Puts your position on the map. On Android 11 and older it is also needed to find nearby devices over Bluetooth.
permissions.battery.title: Run in the background
permissions.battery.desc: Let the app keep receiving messages when the screen is off — Android otherwise puts it to sleep
permissions.internet.title: Internet
permissions.internet.desc: Connect to the internet relays and the wapp store (automatic)
permissions.banner.bluetooth: Bluetooth is not allowed, so phones nearby can't reach you. The internet still works. Tap to allow it.
permissions.location.switch_off: Location is switched off on this phone, so there is no position on the map.
permissions.location.switch_off_ble: Location is switched off on this phone. On this Android version Bluetooth finds no one until it is on.
permissions.bluetooth.without: Without it: no messages with phones nearby, only over the internet.
permissions.nearby_wifi.without: Without it: large files to nearby phones go over Bluetooth, more slowly.
permissions.notifications.without: Without it: no alerts while XPRS is in the background.
permissions.storage.without: Without it: no identity backup that survives a reinstall, and no browsing your folders.
permissions.storage_legacy.without: Without it: no identity backup that survives a reinstall, and no browsing your folders.
permissions.location.without: Without it: no position on the map (and on Android 11 or older, no Bluetooth).
permissions.battery.without: Without it: Android may pause XPRS while the screen is off, so messages arrive later.
